tagline: 美能达便携相机，1986 年发布
description: 美能达于1986年推出的便携相机。配备35 mm f/2,8 (4 elements, 4 groups).。使用Automatic loading, advance and rewind. Continuous shooting mode available.。感光度0,65—4 m. Out of range warning.。Active infrared autofocus. Focus from 0,65 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus. Focus from 0,65 m to infinity.
specs.曝光测光: EV 8.4 (1/40 s, f/2,8) to EV 18 (1/800 s, f/18) with ISO 100 film. Narrow light metering angle.
specs.胶片/画幅: Automatic loading, advance and rewind. Continuous shooting mode available.
specs.英文简介: The AF-Z (or MAC-7 in Japan) was one of Minolta's higher-speced compact cameras upon its release in 1986.
